summary.headline: R K Swamy Q4 FY26 consolidated total income rose about 15% YoY to INR 351.73 crore, with EBITDA up 31.6% to about INR 55 crore.
summary.overview: Management reported consolidated total income of about INR 351.73 crore for FY26, up roughly 15% YoY, with EBITDA up 31.6% to about INR 55 crore and EBITDA margin improving from about 13.5% to about 15.5%. Profit before exceptional item (labour code impact) rose about 30%, and management said Q4 also saw higher top line, bottom line and margins. The company stated it is investing ahead of client needs in CX centres, a digital video studio, a consulting group and AI tools, while the balance sheet remains debt-free. On the call, management said client budgets are not being cut but commitments may be delayed amid macro and geopolitical volatility.

financial_highlights.change: about +30% YoY; exceptional item is labour code impact
improved from last year; pre-IPO above 20%

segments.name: Communications (R K Swamy Ltd standalone)
segments.commentary: Management estimated about 44-45% of top line comes from communications on standalone financials. Communications repeat business is 85-90%.

segments.name: Research (Hansa Research Group)
segments.commentary: Research is about one-fourth of top line. International research engagement continued to grow, and management cited high-margin international research projects.

segments.name: Data analytics and CX (Hansa Customer Equity)
segments.commentary: Analytics is about 30% of top line; HCE including CX centres is about 30-31% of total income. Analytics repeat business is over 90%. Management said analytics has scaled from zero to about INR 100 crore over the last decade.

segments.name: Customer experience centres
segments.commentary: CX infrastructure expanded by about 50%; utilisation was about 83% on 31 March 2026 and is expected to move beyond 91% by end of Q1 FY27.

guidance_outlook: No numeric revenue or margin guidance given; management declined to provide ballpark growth or steady-state margin figures.
Management said it expects CX utilisation to move beyond 91% by end of Q1 FY27.

Digital video studio expected to become operational in the current year; investment is about INR 11 crore (facilities, IT and real estate, per management, a SEBI-approved project cost with a monitoring agency); personnel spend for consulting and studio is single-digit crore.
Management said current year environment looks 'a little dicey' given the war-related volatility; budgets are not being cut but commitments may be delayed.
Management said it will not deploy surplus cash foolishly; capital return plans are 'too early' to outline.
capex_capacity: Customer experience centre infrastructure increased by about 50% over the last two years; utilisation about 83% at 31 March 2026.
Digital video studio under way, approx. INR 11 crore total project cost; leased space in South Bombay under a letter of intent signed.
Studio intended to improve turnaround and reduce dependence on outsourced production, which will continue but reduce.
Brand and Marketing Consulting Group initiated in Q1 FY26, with early validation encouraging.
Business described as asset-light; investments funded from cash reserves and accruals.
demand_pricing: Repeat business is 75-85% of revenue in aggregate (about 85% per management); 80-85% of revenue from existing clients.
Seasonality: about 40% of revenue in first half and 60% in second half; Q4 described as important as clients exhaust budgets.
Four key sectors cited as all firing: BFSI, FMCG/retail, automotive, pharma/healthcare; presence strongest in BFSI, FMCG and automotive.
Clients with two or more services contribute about 30% of total income; management said multi-service clients rose from under 5% to 25-30% of clients.
Management said it avoids the price game and aims to hold pricing; new clients largely come via invitation or RFP.
Early FY27 budget read: budgets are holding, commitments may be delayed; still negotiating with many clients as of May.

qa_highlights.question: Why do revenue and margins fluctuate quarter to quarter, what drove FY23-FY25 dip, and what steady-state margin and growth should be expected?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the business is seasonal (40/60 H1/H2 split) and lumpy due to large project wins; no numeric steady-state margin or growth guidance was given, and management pointed to operating leverage, moving up the value chain and technology as drivers over a cycle.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 8.5% EBITDA figure from the cash flow statement sustainable, after deducting lease liability?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it looks at total income-based EBITDA, which was about 15.5% vs 13.5% a year ago, and did not accept the 8.5% derived figure.

qa_highlights.question: Does AI threaten disintermediation, and what is the digital video studio capex?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the studio is INR 11 crore, will use AI extensively, and AI is a tool that needs human intervention; disintermediation is not expected.

qa_highlights.question: Market share and right-to-win versus MNC peers?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said market share is low, the company is positioned as independent and faster than MNCs, has no plans for layoffs, and claims quality wins against MNCs in competitive pitches.

qa_highlights.question: Segment mix and the revenue split across integrated marketing, analytics and services?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said segments are integrated and revenue split is not clean; using standalone financials, communications about 44-45%, research about one-fourth, analytics about 30%.

qa_highlights.question: Employee expense trend despite adding about 600 CX and 300-340 telephone interview staff?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said headcount rose over 600 people in 12-14 months, increments were muted, new hires came at lower price points, and apprentice costs sit in other expenses.

qa_highlights.question: Client budgets and advertising spend outlook for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said budgets are not being cut but commitments may be delayed as clients wait and see; still early in May with negotiations ongoing.

qa_highlights.question: Capital allocation, ROCE and shareholder returns?
qa_highlights.answer: ROCE about 9.3% (pre-IPO above 20%); management said it will deploy cash in a measured way and it is too early to outline shareholder returns; INR 44 crore earmarked for IPO purposes and INR 136 crore on balance sheet as cited by an investor.

risks_watch: Revenue lumpiness from large project timing; quarterly margins swing sharply (analyst cited Q3 about 11% vs Q4 about 22%).
Client budget commitments delayed amid geopolitical and macro volatility; FY27 visibility limited.
Talent-driven model: scaling analytics and consulting depends on hiring scarce data and consulting talent.
Disclosure gaps: segment revenue not disclosed on a clean basis; management declined to break out CX revenue beyond referring to HCE numbers.
Execution of the digital video studio and the consulting group; returns on the INR 11 crore studio not quantified.
ROCE about 9.3% is low for a services business; capital allocation and cash deployment plan not yet defined.
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term positioning and growth, but cautious and somewhat evasive on numeric guidance, FY27 outlook and capital return plans. Management repeatedly declined to give forecasts and framed the year as volatile.
key_quotes: A photograph may capture the peak, but investors usually value the movie.
AI cannot displace what we can do, my friend.
We are in a quadrant of one.
The budgets are not being cut.

adds.what: Digital video studio (leased space in South Bombay under LOI), approx. INR 11 crore project cost
CX centre infrastructure expanded by about 50% over last two years (utilisation ~83% at 31 Mar 2026, expected beyond 91% by end Q1 FY27)

growth.why: No numeric revenue guidance; management said FY27 environment is 'a little dicey' with budgets not cut but commitments possibly delayed, while CX utilisation is expected to rise from 83% to beyond 91% by end Q1 FY27 and a ~INR 11 crore digital video studio is under way.
